process.title: How we [work]
process.intro: Clear steps from the first message to the final files. Everything below is written into the quotation before work starts.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: You send a request with a short brief. We talk through the details, the goal and the timing.

steps.title: Quotation
steps.text: I send a quotation with the scope, deliverables, timeline, price and payment terms.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.text: Work starts once the quotation is approved and 50% of the total is paid.

steps.title: First results
steps.text: I share the first results for your feedback and approval.

steps.title: Revisions
steps.text: Three rounds of revisions are included. Any extra round is charged at the rate in the quotation.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: On final approval the remaining 50% is paid and the final files are delivered in full.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Every project is different, so I price it after we talk. Send a request with your brief and you get a clear quotation with no hidden costs.
It depends on the project. The quotation states the timeline, and it starts once the deposit is paid and I have everything I need from you.
A round of changes to the work you approved in the first results. A new idea or a change of direction is a new request.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Design, 3D, drawing and editing work fully online. Filming and photography are in the UAE.
You get full rights to use the final files once the last payment is made. I may show the work in my portfolio unless we agree otherwise.
Yes. Many projects combine design, 3D and video. Tell me what you need and I'll put one package together.

cta: Tell me about your project and I'll reply with next steps and a quote.
